reviews.comment: My favorite prof. Sometimes gets off topic during lecture but it's so so funny&he notes what you need to know for exams! Gives bonus points if you just ask&you get to bring a page front and back to exams. Loved this class & this professor. If you get the change to take him you won't regret it! I don't know how many times I laughed during lecture

HIGHLY recommend taking him for SOCI 205!! Super easy class and the material isn't hard to understand at all.  Extra credit on every test and for asking questions in class.  There is no homework, and he provides test reviews which are very helpful.  He would sometimes get off topic but would always complete teaching the material for the tests!!

By far easiest class/professor I have ever taken. Showed up the first day of class and never came back except for exams. Made an A on every exam. Provides a lot of extra credit if you want, just attend class and participate. If you want an easy A take this class with this guy. He's awesome, funny, and his exams are slight work.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The prof is funny, lectures aren't mandatory, and the material isn't hard at all. Your entire grade is composed of 4 exams that are based entirely on the lecture powerpoint and you can even bring a double-sided sheet of paper with notes for the test. If you study the powerpoints before tests you are set for an easy A.

Took him for my mandatory SOCI420 class. The best professor I have ever taken and he has the best sense of humor! Allows you to rewrite papers and gives tons of extra credit, goes over the homework questions(which is incredibly helpful). Would take him again 100%, he is very accommodating and understanding. My favorite professor ever!

Anyone who has anything bad to say about professor Sakamoto is just a bitter soul who didn't do anything to get a good grade in his class. He is extremely understanding of students personal matters and jumps to lend a helping hand where possible. He is funny and his class is not nearly as hard as SOCI 220 #teamsakamoto

Love Dr. Sakamoto! Hes extremely smart and great at teaching statistics. Hes also really funny and easy to talk to. Lets you use a page of notes for exams and has review sessions before the exams. The final project is kind of difficult but he tells you very clearly what to do if you pay attention in class and hes willing to help in office hours
Dr. Sakamoto has wonderful personality and really cares about his students. My only complaint is how intensive the final research project. It was brutal.
There are 3 exams only thats all you worry about. He is super chill and his review day is the most helpful for the exam. highly recommend!

Dr. Sakamoto is a great professor!!! He always make sure people understand and gives extra credit. He cares if you learn and always available for help. He made statistics very interesting which is hard to do.

He is not very accommodating or helpful. Participation is required but he has a terrible system in which he "awards" participation points. If you have more points than required than they count as bonus points, so if you're not outgoing, loud, or quick to answer you'll get run over by all of the other eager beavers.

This professor is not a great about talking about the chapters, the book is used, read all the chapter because there are extra credit questions. Overall not a bad class but need to put in the work to get good outcome.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The lectures are not super exciting, but he is hilarious in between discussion. He posts all of his information for the tests online and as long as you study it and do the readings you don't need to go to class other than getting the attendance points.

His class was very easy overall. All you have to do is go to class, write everything he says, and study that. You don't even need the book if you take good notes. I got a B on the first test cause I wasn't really sure what to expect but on the rest of the exams I got As. He also gives some extra credit.

Sakamoto is a good professor. He can get off on tangents sometimes, but otherwise, write down everything he says pertaining to the notes and you'll pass easily. His exams aren't bad at all. He gives extra credit for participation. Basically everything on the exams is straight from lecture, so don't skip class. He is extremely fun to listen to.

What an amazing professor. He is hilarious and makes the tests as simple as possible. All you have to do is show up and pay attention and you will get 105s on all of your exams (he has extra credit points at the end of each exam). I would definitely take his class over again. Also gives extra credit if you participate in class!

He is a very nice guy and seems to really care about his students.   He goes with the flow.    You should participate in class because he really likes his students to give their input.    His tests have extra credit on them if you need it.   I would take his class again given the chance.

Sakamoto-sensei has got to be one of the best professors in the sociology department. I actually felt like going to class because his lectures were interesting, and he made me laugh every day. I literally regretted the times I was unable to attend. Tests are easy if you go to class and pay attention. Gives EC opportunities for those who need it!

I loved Dr. Sakamoto! Because he is a third-generation Japanese American, he does not have a Japanese accent. There were 2 homework assignments, 2 tests, and 1 final. All of these were VERY easy. You get extra credit for participation and going to class. He is hilarious and made the class very enjoyable. He is the best professor I have had at A&M!
